briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies US-China AGI race as compute bottlenecks tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid regulatory scrutiny. US export controls and Chinese domestic chip advances reshape global supply chains. Multi-agent security protocols gain traction as deployment scales.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with 4x reasoning gains; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus; Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 3; Meta open-sources Llama 4 400B; xAI releases Grok-3; DeepSeek drops V4. Training runs exceed 10^27 FLOPs at leading labs.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: EU AI Act enforcement begins with fines for non-compliance. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 3M units monthly; Microsoft and Google announce $40B combined data center builds in Texas and Arizona. TSMC 2nm yields improve to 65% for AI accelerators.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will export controls successfully delay Chinese AGI timelines by more than 18 months?
